tagline: Rayong's national-park island — a proven Ban Phe day-trip, now an Eastern Seaboard node.
summary: Koh Samet is a small national-park island off Rayong, ~3 nm from the mainland pier at Ban Phe and a long-established weekend and day-trip destination for Bangkok and the Eastern Economic Corridor. Today it is reached by a 15-min diesel speedboat from Ban Phe; with the Eastern Seaboard network it becomes a direct ~40 nm Pioneer II run from Pattaya as well as a clean Ban Phe gateway shuttle.

demand_signals.detail: High weekend and holiday speedboat flow from Ban Phe to Koh Samet's Na Dan pier — a proven, repeated leg.
Mu Ko Samet National Park status sustains steady leisure demand from Bangkok and the EEC.
A direct Pattaya line removes the ~2.5hr drive to Ban Phe for Pattaya-origin guests.

use_cases: Ban Phe <-> Koh Samet premium gateway shuttle
Pattaya <-> Koh Samet direct island day-trip
Weekend leisure transfer from the EEC

journeys.note: Direct Eastern Seaboard line, in Pioneer II range.

navier_fit: High for the gateway leg (proven volume, short crossing); the direct Pattaya line is a clean ~40 nm Pioneer II hop that opens a new origin. Charging at Ban Phe pedestal.
competitive_landscape: Diesel speedboats on fixed schedules from Ban Phe; no premium or in-app tier; no direct Pattaya service.
seasonality: Peak: Nov-Apr cool/dry; the upper Gulf here is more sheltered than the open lower Gulf, giving a broad operating window.
regulatory_note: Thai Marine Department licensing; Mu Ko Samet National Park rules and park fees apply at the island.

precedents.label: Ban Phe ferry operators
precedents.note: Established high-frequency speedboat market — the demand a foiling tier upgrades.

grab.super_app_fit: In-app Koh Samet day-trip bundles (boat + GrabCar) originating from Pattaya or Ban Phe.
grab.wedge: Direct Pattaya->Koh Samet line bundled in Grab as an Eastern Seaboard day-trip — no 2.5hr drive to Ban Phe.
